::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 31st  [1855-9]  
**From:** [Dogmersfield](organizations/other_121.qmd)  
**Manuscript:** MS formerly in the Royal Institution of Cornwall, Enys No. 1428[^1]
:::

Madam
I am much obliged for your great kindness in allowing [my mother](people/person_1606.qmd) and myself the perusal of the enclosed valuable letter.  I have been from home for some days, or I would sooner have returned it, and expressed our best thanks for the favour of its perusal

yours much obliged
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

**Note:** Probably dating between the death of WCY and the death of the Rev. Charles Dyson in 1860.
